maya (partnerships): Aurora Edge proposed a joint perf/W + throughput bench for marketplace listing. Quick sync on scope?
diego (eng-runtime): I'll own orchestration. Need matrix: models, seq, batch, quant, kernel variants, power sample rate.
leo (Aurora Edge HW): We can provide 5 nodes, per-node power at 5Hz, and an optimized kernel (aurora-prefetch). We'll expose s3://aurora-edge/telemetry/redwood.
tara (eng-ml): Models: 7B (gpt-like) and 13B. Seq 512/1024. Batches 1/4/8. Quants q4_0, q8_0. Capture 40 eval prompts for quality. Kernel: stock vs aurora-prefetch.
maya (partnerships): Timeline: need numbers for marketplace and a 2-sentence partner quote. When can runs start?
leo (Aurora Edge HW): Nodes available next Wed. Prefer runs during 09:00-17:00 PT. We'll need runner creds and test schedule by Monday.
diego (eng-runtime): Proposed measurement: 3 min warmup, 5 min steady state, power @5Hz, collect per-token latency hist and token/sec. I'll compute tokens/sec per watt and p99 latency at p50 throughput.
tara (eng-ml): Also save generated outputs for the eval prompts to check regressions. I'll prepare prompt pack and baseline today.
ci-bot: CI pipeline created: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/aurora-edge-dryrun (dry runs nightly).
maya (partnerships): Action items: @diego runner + CSV schema + CI, @tara prompt pack + eval harness, @leo provision nodes + s3 + kernel builds, partnerships draft marketplace blurb. Checkpoint Thurs 9am PT.
diego (eng-runtime): I'll post runner PR with example command today.
leo (Aurora Edge HW): Opening infra ticket for kernel-logs to go to aurora-debug bucket for prefetch runs.
maya (partnerships): Perfect. I'll schedule Thu 9am and start a blurb draft after first dry-run. :rocket:
